name: Judge.me
label: Judge.me REST v1 — reviews
description: Private api_token as recommended X-Api-Token header, and still as query api_token (docs allow both). shop_domain required. Never log reviewer email/body. Docs: https://judge.me/api/docs
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One official API operation. Secrets stay in configurationParameters.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official API verb. EXACT: review_list | review_create. Blank uses configurationParameters.operation. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not an HTTP call.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Reviewer email. Official body email for review_create. Example: ada@example.com. Never log.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Reviewer display name for review_create. Example: Ada.

schema.label: rating
schema.description: Star rating 1–5 for review_create. Official rating. Example: 5.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Review title for review_create. Official title.

schema.label: body
schema.description: Review text for review_create. Official body.

schema.label: product_id
schema.description: Judge.me product id for review_create. One of product_id / product_handle / product_external_id is required.

schema.label: product_external_id
schema.description: Platform product id (e.g. Shopify product id) for review_create.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Optional reviewer external id for review_create.

schema.label: platform
schema.description: Platform slug for review_create. Typical: shopify | bigcommerce | woocommerce. Example: shopify.

schema.label: ip_addr
schema.description: Reviewer IP for review_create. Official ip_addr.

schema.label: shop_domain
schema.description: Shop domain query (also config). review_list and review_create. Example: example.myshopify.com.

ports.name: output
ports.description: status=ok + data on 2xx. Secrets never present. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status. Never includes secrets.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. May contain order PII — do not log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb for OfficialApiNode. EXACT: review_list | review_create. trigger does not open a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Api Token
configurationParameters.description: StudioQuack secret. Sent as X-Api-Token (recommended) and as query api_token (still documented). Never log. Customer owns the merchant account.

configurationParameters.label: Shop Domain
configurationParameters.description: Shop domain sent as query shop_domain on every call. Example: example.myshopify.com.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout seconds (connect + read). <=0 uses api_spec defaultTimeout.
